page_title: ALA 2-0 PAL | Alaves v Las Palmas 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Luka Romero (Alaves) can't convert the spot kick. It goes narrowly wide of the right post.
90+4' Luka Romero (Alaves) is going to take the penalty!
90+4' The referee blows his whistle as Marvin (Las Palmas) was too aggressive in his challenge. PENALTY to Alaves! Great chance to score.
90+2' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

88' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) displays brilliant awareness inside the box to pounce on the rebound. From a difficult position he directs a header towards the middle of the net, but Antonio Sivera pulls off a decent save to deny him.
88' Marvin (Las Palmas) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
84' The corner is swung in but Las Palmas can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Victor Garcia had an easy-decision to make.
82' Today's match ends for Carlos Vicente who will be replaced by Luka Romero (Alaves).
82' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Jon Guridi will be replaced by Hugo Novoa Ramos (Alaves).

78' 2 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Toni Martinez (Alaves) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Jasper Cillessen just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:0.
77' Substitution. Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) on for Kirian Rodriguez.
76' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
73' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
72' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and it's Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
72' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Antonio Sivera easily deals with the threat.
70' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Ander Guevara (Alaves) replaces Stoichkov.
69' Las Palmas are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
68' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
64' Substitution. Jose Campana makes his way off the pitch and Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) comes on as his replacement.
64' Here is a change. Kike Garcia is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Toni Martinez (Alaves).
64' That's the end of the game for Tomas Conechny, who is replaced by Carlos Martin (Alaves).
63' A pass lands at the feet of Antonio Blanco (Alaves) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
62' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
61' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off the line to clear the ball away.
58' Luis Carrion has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marvin (Las Palmas) replacing Viti.
58' Substitution. Jaime Mata walks off the pitch and Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) comes on as a substitute.
58' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Jasper Cillessen comes off his line to gather the ball.
57' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
56' Kike Garcia (Alaves) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
55' Poorly taken free kick by Carlos Vicente (Alaves) from mid-range. He unleashes a strong shot, but it goes well wide of the right post. What a miskick!
54' Viti (Las Palmas) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
53' What a chance that is! Stoichkov (Alaves) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.

52' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Jasper Cillessen keeps it out.
50' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) is penalised for a foul. Victor Garcia had a clear view and blows his whistle.
49' Las Palmas take a short corner kick.

48' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The linesman makes the right call and Las Palmas will have a corner.
47' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' Half-time substitution. Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) is replaced by Alberto Moleiro.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' A cross by Carlos Vicente (Alaves) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
45+3' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off the line to clear the ball away.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tomas Conechny (Alaves) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
44' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
44' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
43' Viti (Las Palmas) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
38' After what seems an eternity, referee Victor Garcia decides there was an offside after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Alaves, play to continue.
38' The Alaves players halt their celebrations as referee Victor Garcia makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
38' Goal! Tomas Conechny (Alaves) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
37' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
35' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
32' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.

31' What a chance that is! Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the left post.
30' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) makes a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
27' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Las Palmas comes to nothing.

26' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the left post, but Antonio Sivera has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Las Palmas force their opponents to concede a corner.
24' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Jon Guridi (Alaves). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
21' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Viti (Las Palmas) but poses no threat.
20' Alaves fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
20' A corner kick by Alaves is thwarted by the well prepared Jasper Cillessen (Las Palmas). The ball goes out for a corner. Alaves can continue in their attacking effort.

19' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.
17' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the right post.
16' Corner kick. Jose Campana (Las Palmas) is ready to send the ball into the box.

15' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Antonio Sivera reacts superbly to deny him. Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Jasper Cillessen scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
14' Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

13' Las Palmas are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
12' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' The foul by Stoichkov (Alaves) was seen by Victor Garcia who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
9' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Stoichkov (Alaves) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
7' 1 - 0 It's 1:0! Stoichkov feeds Carlos Vicente (Alaves) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
5' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
5' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
4' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Victor Garcia no option but to blow his whistle.
3' Las Palmas keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Las Palmas will take the kick-off.
Victor Garcia was nominated as the referee for this game.
